# Chris Chingren Joins Alerus as Regional Vice President, Retirement Sales


##### August 20, 2026


Alerus is pleased to announced Chris Chingren has joined the company as a regional vice president of retirement sales, serving financial advisors in Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Nebraska, and Oklahoma.


Chris has more than 15 years of experience in the retirement industry, with an extensive background in client service and relationship management. He focuses on building strong relationships with advisors by providing subject matter expertise and support to help them better serve their clients. Chris holds FINRA Series 6, 63, and 7 securities registrations. Before joining Alerus, he spent 10 years as a client relationship manager at Voya Financial.


He is based in Overland Park, Kansas.
